                  Control Center

                  Run the whole workspace

                  Monitor operations, control roles, and decide which modules every staff member can see.

                  ✅ Live & connected — role and visibility changes below save immediately to the database, no separate migration needed.
                  A quick snapshot — use the tabs above to make changes.

                  Settings

                  Workspace-wide switches — off here means off for everyone.

                  Module Covers

                  Give a module tile a colored cover instead of the plain card background — visible to everyone who can see that module.

                  Quick Links

                  Company links shown on everyone's Home page (HR portal, ERP, etc).

                  Email notifications

                  Turn specific kinds of emails off without touching the master switch above.

                  Module visibility

                  Click a module to see — and change — exactly who it's visible to, without going staff member by staff member.

                  Custom Modules

                  Add a module tile without a code change — one link for everyone, a different link per person (e.g. each merchant's own dashboard), or paste in a block of HTML. It opens inside the app like any other module. Show/hide it per staff member from Staff Controls → Visibility, or above.

                  Teams

                  Group staff into teams with one TL each — Leave and Reimbursement requests route to the requester's team TL automatically.

                  Buyer Email Directory

                  Buyer code → email, one row per buyer. The Buyer Order Dashboard's "send to buyer" emails use this list directly — edit a row here and the next send picks it up, no Sheet or script edit needed.

                  Buyer visit notify list

                  These people get an email whenever a buyer visit is logged. Set once here — no need to pick recipients per visit.

                  Buyer visit — Home page alert

                  Whoever's checked here sees an "Upcoming Buyer Visits" card on their own Home page (buyer, time, who's attending) — it disappears on its own once the visit time passes. Separate from the email list above.

                  Inspection notify list

                  These people get an email whenever an inspection is logged. Set once here — no need to pick recipients per visit.

                  Inspection — Home page alert

                  Whoever's checked here sees an "Upcoming Inspections" card on their own Home page (person, buyer, reason, time) — it disappears on its own once the visit time passes. Separate from the email list above.

                  Staff access

                  Toggle what each person can see and do, or edit their details.
